messages:
teri: Heads-up: import from partner X tagged 6.2k accounts as 'onboard:next-step' and our auto-playbook kicked off. We're getting support tickets. Can someone pause outgoing nudges?

ops-bot: playbook-runner: run id pr-20260323-01 started 2026-03-23T06:12:03Z, recipients: 6204, phase: sending.

ash: Paused the playbook (Admin -> Playbooks -> onboard-next). Stopping worker now. Please don't run any manual sends to that cohort.

neha: Quick triage numbers: 6,204 recipients, of which ~310 are renewals within 45 days, ~95 marked high-touch (ae_required=true).

teri: Next steps: 1) suppress cohort so no further outbound 2) run owner backfill dry-run on 300 accounts 3) prepare short apology email for trials only.

ash: Suppression uploaded to s3://cs-ops/tmp/suppress-20260323.csv. Dry-run command: `python cs_tools/claim_owners.py --cohort partnerx-20260322 --limit 300 --dry-run`.

neha: Dry-run result: ~1,450 strong owner candidates (email exact), 540 fuzzy. We'll auto-claim exact matches only.

teri: For mitigation: add a preflight step for all import cohorts that flags >1% renewals or >5000 recipients and requires manager approval. Also default new playbooks to `dry_run=true`.

ops-bot: playbook-runner: pr-20260323-01 paused by ash at 2026-03-23T06:19:50Z. recipients_sent: 2,912.

ash: I'll update the playbook template and post the config diffs in the CS runbook. neha, can you draft the apology copy? Keep it terse and only to trials.

neha: Draft in thread: "Sorry — you may have received an automated onboarding message in error. If this impacted you, reply here or use this one-minute survey [link]."

teri: Thanks team. We'll run the gated backfill in 20m and hold any cohort outreach until then. Posting incident notes and tagging Product + Integrations for a follow-up retro.
